name: Favor
overview: Scripture reveals that favor, often described as grace or blessing, is a divine response to the righteous and faithful, as seen in Noah finding grace in the eyes of the LORD and Joseph gaining favor with his master. Favor is portrayed as a protective and life-giving presence, surrounding the believer like a shield and bringing joy after trials. It is also evident in relational contexts, where Esther and others are granted favor in the sight of those in authority, demonstrating God's sovereign hand in elevating His people.
